title: Chefmakes' Custom Peaceful
description: This is a peaceful mod for people who might want more out of peaceful, not less
body:
![TITLECARD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d565f2b1df53d9f5e4ea75bbd307e6475b611e82.png)

This is a mod for people who want to enjoy the benifits of peaceful, but also don't want to lose out on most of the feature's the game has. This mod aims to provide the best of both world's for the player; Allowing them to play the game in peace, but also not stunting their progress by unwanted features such as removing ALL hostile mobs (including ones important for the progression).

You activate this mod via a command and NOT in the difficulty tab:
![command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cfeb2ba9df49e22c177d78233a2f1c4d7cb8fdbb.png)

You have the option to turn this gamemode on or off but more importantly, you can control the spawnrates of the (hostile) mobs around you; In the sense that:\
0 ------> no spawns at all\
0.25 ---> quarter the spawnrate\
0.5  ---> half the spawnrate\
1 ------> default amount\
2 ------> double the spawnrate\
3 ------> triple\
.\
.\
and so on

Now the benifits of this mod actually are:

1. Hostile mobs, even if they spawn, aren't aggressive towards you
2. You're immune to explostions but still recieve knockback
3. You regenerate health similarly to peaceful
4. Your hunger regenerates fully if it goes below 1
5. You can shear both blazes and breezes to aquire the blaze/breeze rods (however it does consume a large amount of durability)
6. You can give a wither skeleton a carved pumpkin in exchange for it's skull
